title: Export your data
intro: Write your Profile, applications, seen jobs, documents and audit log to a folder you choose, in open formats that another tool can read.
warning.title: This export is not encrypted
warning.body: Anyone who can open the folder can read everything in it: your Profile, your applications, your documents and your audit log. Store it somewhere you control, and delete it when you are done.
warning.ack: I understand this export is not encrypted.
